title: The Brownian transport map
tldr_zh: 用 Föllmer 过程构造 Wiener 测度到目标测度的传输映射，在 OT 映射收缩性开放情形证明几乎必然收缩，导出新泛函不等式与 Stein kernel 结果
tldr_en: Constructs a transport map via the Föllmer process from Wiener measure to Euclidean target measures, proving almost-sure contraction where OT map contraction is open, yielding new functional inequalities and Stein kernels
